paper_title: Ultralight Dark Matter Search with Space-Time Separated Atomic Clocks and Cavities
suggested_experiment_name: Space-time separated clocks/cavities (GPS + Cavities, this work)
coupling_convention: |d_me| dimensionless, emitted as absolute values (y-axis plots log10|d_me|)
notes: Paper presents first constraints on scalar DM coupling to electrons d_me alone for masses 1e-19 to 2e-15 eV, using NPL/PTB cavity-cavity fiber-link comparison (spatial term) and GPS Rb microwave clocks vs H-maser (temporal term). The dark-matter-induced signal amplitude is noted to be approximately mass-independent (flat in mass) because phi0 ~ 1/m and signal ~ omega*phi0. Numerical limit values are only shown in Fig. 2 (log10|dme| vs log10 mass), not tabulated; the emitted d_me values are rough order-of-magnitude estimates and are NOT reliably digitized — treat data_points as placeholder. Local DM density assumed 0.4 GeV/cm^3.
